keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Toni Borevković (Vitoria Guimaraes) is shown the yellow card.
João Mendes (Vitoria Guimaraes) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Vitoria Guimaraes 0, FC Porto 1. Borja Sainz (FC Porto) right footed shot from very close range to the top left corner. Assisted by Alberto Costa with a cross.
Borja Sainz (FC Porto) is shown the yellow card for excessive celebration.
Pablo Rosario (FC Porto) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Vitoria Guimaraes 0, FC Porto 1.
Second Half begins Vitoria Guimaraes 0, FC Porto 1.
Substitution, FC Porto. André Silva replaces Samu Aghehowa.
Substitution, FC Porto. Alan Varela replaces Pablo Rosario.
Substitution, FC Porto. Martim Fernandes replaces Borja Sainz.
Substitution, Vitoria Guimaraes. Alan replaces Samu.
Delay in match because of an injury Jan Bednarek (FC Porto).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, FC Porto. Nehuén Pérez replaces Jan Bednarek because of an injury.
Substitution, FC Porto. Hwang In-Beom replaces Gabri Veiga.
Hwang In-Beom (FC Porto) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Vitoria Guimaraes. Alioune Ndoye replaces Arnel Jakupović.
Goal! Vitoria Guimaraes 1, FC Porto 1. Alan (Vitoria Guimaraes) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Gustavo Silva.
Substitution, FC Porto. Santiago Giménez replaces Alberto Costa.
Substitution, Vitoria Guimaraes. Miguel Nogueira replaces Gustavo Silva.
Substitution, Vitoria Guimaraes. Thiago Balieiro replaces Ahmed Sidibé.
Substitution, Vitoria Guimaraes. Lohann Doucet replaces Beni Mukendi.
Goal! Vitoria Guimaraes 1, FC Porto 2. Martim Fernandes (FC Porto) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Pepê following a fast break.
Delay in match because of an injury Martim Fernandes (FC Porto).
Delay in match because of an injury Toni Borevković (Vitoria Guimaraes).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Vitoria Guimaraes. Patrick Ouotro replaces Toni Borevković because of an injury.
Substitution, FC Porto. Dominik Prpic replaces Pepê.
Alan Varela (FC Porto) is shown the yellow card.
Second Half ends, Vitoria Guimaraes 1, FC Porto 2.
